candidates.title: Damaged metro cars offered at public auction
candidates.search_snippet: Damaged metro cars offered at public auction.
candidates.source_content: Two metro cars damaged in an accident last year have been put up for sale on a public auction website with a starting price far below their original cost. The operator decided under its asset rules to scrap the damaged cars and sell them at auction. Bids close at the end of the month.
